about.title: Strength, nourishment, and a quiet kind of confidence.
about.calling: We all have a calling in life. My calling is to help people.
about.story: Trained at SNF Academy, graduated from Awakening School of Ministry. I help people move forward — the right food, the right mindset, the right movement. At any age.
about.storyMovement: I have been active in sports since I was a little girl. I was interested in all kinds of sports.
about.storyNourish: Over time, I learned that food is not just for filling us up, but mainly for nourishing us. And in the last few years, I have really understood how much impact our internal health has on our overall existence.
about.storyEducation: I had the opportunity to study at SNF Academy, where I studied Personal Trainer and Nutrition coach. And after that I was accepted to the Awakening School of Ministry, where I successfully completed my studies.
about.storyMission: My dream is to help people move forward in their lives. With exercise, proper nutrition, and healthy thinking, everyone can have a better quality of life. Even though we haven't lived our best life so far in these areas of life, nothing is lost, because our bodies are made to recover when we give them what they need.
about._storyOriginal: After my study at SNF Academy, where I studied Personal Trainer and Nutrition coach, and graduating from Awakening School of Ministry, I help people move forward in their lives. With the right diet, the right mindset, and the right exercise. At any age.

mission.title: Your best years are not behind you, they’re the ones you’re about to create.
mission.p1:
We all have something that gives our life meaning, something that makes us feel alive.
I am fulfilled when I can help improve the quality of life of people who desire it.
mission.p2:
My first priority is always health, whether it is physical or mental.
We can be the most beautiful in the world, but what good is that if we can’t say the same about our inner self.
That’s why it’s important to not only exercise, but also eat well, think healthy, and maintain a healthy lifestyle.
mission.p3: Let me tell you. It’s never too late.
mission.body:
We all have something that gives our life meaning, something that makes us feel alive.
I am fulfilled when I can help improve the quality of life of people who desire it.

My first priority is always health, whether it is physical or mental.

That’s why it’s important to not only exercise, but also eat well, think healthy, and maintain a healthy lifestyle.
mission.p4: And I will do my best to help you.

sampleNotice._comment: Shown next to the testimonials while TESTIMONIALS_ARE_REAL is false (lib/content-status.ts). Delete nothing here when real stories arrive — flip the flag.
sampleNotice.label: Sample content
sampleNotice.body: These stories were written while the site was being built. They are not from real clients, and no before/after photos have been shared with anyone. They stay here as a placeholder until Katey has real ones to put in their place.

spotlight.quote: I came in wanting to lose weight. Six weeks later, the weight had shifted — but the bigger thing was quieter. For the first time in years I looked in the mirror without doing math. Katey didn't sell me a program; she walked with me through one.
spotlight.name: Lena, 32

testimonials.title: What changed wasn't only the body.

marcus.name: Marcus, 41
marcus.quote: As a guy I wasn't sure this was for me. Katey made it feel like coaching, not therapy — and the spiritual conversations were real, never pushy.

hannah.name: Hannah, 27
hannah.quote: Six weeks. The first program I've finished without giving up halfway. The grace she leads with is part of why.

sophie.name: Sophie, 36
sophie.quote: I wanted structure and got that — but also permission to stop white-knuckling my body. That shift didn't come from a plan. It came from being seen.

faq.title: Honest answers, before you commit.
faq.intro: Anything else? Ask when you write.

believer.q: Do I have to be a believer to work with you?
believer.a: No. The spiritual part is offered, never required. Two of the three programs leave it out entirely.

women.a: Built with women in mind first — men are openly welcome, especially in training and nutrition.

how.q: How does a program actually work?
how.a: A free conversation first. Then your plan, a weekly one-on-one session, and me alongside for six weeks.

gym.q: Do I need a gym membership?
gym.a: Usually not. I build the training around what you have — home, gym, or in between.

beginner.q: What if I haven't trained in years — or ever?
beginner.a: That is most of who I work with. No prerequisites, no judgment.
